mapper.select: SELECT t.id AS id, t.transaction_type AS transactionType, t.created_at AS createdAt, t.transaction_date AS transactionDate, to_a.account_id AS toAccountCode, from_a.account_id AS fromAccountCode, t.amount AS amount, UPPER(c.code) AS currencyCode, t.description AS description, t.remark AS remark, t.created_by AS createdBy FROM transactions t INNER JOIN currency c ON c.id = t.currency_id AND c.tenant_id = t.tenant_id INNER JOIN account to_a ON to_a.id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN account from_a ON from_a.id = t.from_account_id WHERE t.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND t.approval_status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY t.transaction_date ASC, t.created_at ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE transactions SET approval_status = 'APPROVED', approved_by = #{approvedBy}, approved_at = NOW() WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{id} AND approval_status = 'PENDING'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO transactions_deleted ( transaction_id, tenant_id, transaction_type, account_id, from_account_id, currency_id, amount, transaction_date, description, remark, approval_status, approved_by, approved_at, created_by, created_at, deleted_by, deleted_at, bank_process_posted_id, rate_group_id ) SELECT t.id, t.tenant_id, t.transaction_type, t.account_id, t.from_account_id, t.currency_id, t.amount, t.transaction_date, t.description, t.remark, 'REJECTED', #{rejectedBy}, NOW(), t.created_by, t.created_at, #{rejectedBy}, NOW(), t.bank_process_posted_id, t.rate_group_id FROM transactions t WHERE t.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND t.id = #{id} AND t.approval_status = 'PENDING'
